title: Concatenate Non-Zero Digits and Multiply by Sum I
summary: Given an integer n, create a new integer x by joining all non-zero digits of n in their original sequence.
statement: Given an integer n, create a new integer x by joining all non-zero digits of n in their original sequence. If n has no non-zero digits, x is 0. Calculate the sum of the digits in x. Return the product of x and the sum.
constraints: Keep the nonzero decimal digits of n in their original order and concatenate them into x.
Compute the sum of those retained digits.
Return x multiplied by the digit sum; use zero if no nonzero digit exists.
hints: Filter decimal digits while preserving order.
Join retained digits to form x.
Their list also provides the required sum.
Multiply the two computed quantities, with an explicit empty result of zero.
editorial: Multiply the two computed quantities, with an explicit empty result of zero.

tests.explanation: The retained digits form 1234 with sum ten, producing 12340.
The retained value and digit sum are both one, producing one.
